description: Cnergyico PK Limited is a Pakistani petroleum company engaged in oil refining, petroleum marketing and petroleum logistics. It operates the country's largest refining complex, with a combined capacity of 156,000 barrels per day at Mouza Kund in Hub, Balochistan, producing LPG, motor gasoline, kerosene, jet fuel, high-speed diesel, naphtha and furnace oil. The company also operates Pakistan's first and only Single Point Mooring offshore terminal and a retail network of more than 475 outlets.
